description: whole_house_fan home. With the offset at the cap a window opens and the occupant presses the whole-house fan on. HVAC is suppressed for the fan and the loop writes nothing; when the fan and the window are done the HVAC restore writes the PLAIN 66 F then one fresh step.

events.note: The hallway thermostat's own sensor: satisfied, so it will not start by itself.
Seed the door/window sensor as closed.
Day classification (cold: heat all night / hot: cool all night).
Bedtime: the sleep band is written and the sleep window (remote sensor in use) begins.
A window is opened (the whole-house fan needs an opening).
The occupant presses the whole-house fan on.
Bedroom cold while the whole-house fan owns the house.

assertions.reason: Precondition: the offset is at the cap before the fan is pressed.
While the whole-house fan owns the house (HVAC suppressed) CA writes no setpoint at all.
When the fan stands down the HVAC restore writes the PLAIN 66 F, then ONE fresh step -- not the stranded 70 F.

notes: Three-exercise protocol (CLAUDE.md section 10), Issue #1194 increment (e). Tier A: the real ClimateAdvisorCoordinator + AutomationEngine under FakeHass/FakeScheduler (use_coordinator=true, so the sleep-sensor listener and the 1-minute timer are real); every assertion is track=integration for that reason and is evaluated, not skipped.

(a) Effectiveness: scratch-copy mutation run of this scenario against the production code (worktree untouched). It FAILS when M01: the whole offset deleted (the write path adds 0 and the check is a no-op); M02: the +4 F cap removed; M05: the whole gate predicate deleted (always PROCEED). Passes unmutated.

(b) Docs <-> production alignment: docs/08-COMPUTATION-REFERENCE.md 'Remote-sensor outer loop on the thermostat setpoint (Issue #1194, increment a)': 'Gates' WHF row; docs/fan-lifecycle-spec.md. Matches production. LIMIT: the open window's pause also closes the gate here (a whole-house fan with no door/window sensor is unsupported, #1200, and the harness forbids it), so the fan term alone is isolated only in tests/test_remote_offset_gates_1194b.py.
(c) Occupant outcome if this regressed: The loop must never push heat against a running whole-house fan, nor restore a stranded +4 F afterwards.

verdict.summary: WHF ownership (with the window open) closes the gate and exits cleanly.
verdict.observed_behavior: No set_temperature from the cap until the restore at 21:41: 66 then 68.
verdict.expected_behavior: Offset forgotten while the fan owns the house; plain target + one step on exit.

name: remote_offset_1194e_whole_house_fan_ownership_closes_the_gate
